lines.text: Do you know how your phone finds the TV to cast to? It basically shouts across your Wi-Fi.
When you tap cast, your phone sends one small message to every device on the network at once, asking who can play video.
The TV answers with its name and address. Speakers and printers answer too, each saying what they can do.
Then your phone talks to the TV directly. Usually it doesn't send the video itself. It tells the TV which video to fetch from the internet.
That shout only travels inside your own network. Your neighbour's TV, behind their router, never hears it.
Orbi uses the same idea. Phones on the same Wi-Fi show up in Nearby, with no login, no pairing, and no app to install.
